==Description==
The '''Builder Elf''' was a summoner enemy that appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had a slightly slow speed and a decent amount of health. The '''Builder Elf''' had one ability, where it would stop moving and build four to six [[Toy Soldier (Cold Ambush)|Toy Soldier]]s.

==Appearance==
The '''Builder Elf''' was a large pale-skinned humanoid. It wore a green shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black and yellow belt, dark green pants, and black shoes. It wore a green Christmas hat, as well as yellow goggles with blue lenses and an apron with black and yellow straps. It wielded a green wooden hammer in its right hand.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this.
**These towers should have their firerate and range boosted by the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] respectively.
*As the '''Builder Elf''' can create hordes of [[Toy Soldier (Cold Ambush)|Toy Soldier]]s, towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies, such as the [[Executioner]] or [[Engineer]], can do pretty well against this.
